out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink located to the right of the 3 vat sink had a red cutting board being stored in it at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL HAND SINKS MUST BE FREE AND OPEN, AVAILABLE FOR EMPLOYEES TO WASH HANDS AT ALL TIMES. EMPLOYEE REMOVED CUTTING BOARD FROM THE HAND WASHING SINK.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL HOME USE PESTICIDE MUST GET THROW AWAY AS IT IS NOT MEANT FOR COMMERCIAL KITCHENS. EMPLOYEE THREW AWAY AT HOME PESTICIDE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Raw chicken and raw beef were being stored above ready to eat whipped cream and gallons of milk.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THE CORRECT WAY TO ORGANIZE RAW FOODS AND READY TO EAT FOODS. PIC REARRANGED WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR SO RAW FOODS WERE BEING STORED BELOW RTE FOODS.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PLEASE OBTAIN AN UP TO DATE CFM CERTIFICATION.
